name: Forever Young with Dr. Pablo Prichard
original_name: Forever Young with Dr. Pablo Prichard
overview: Hosted by Danielle Robb, and featuring Dr. Pablo Prichard along with other subject matter experts, Forever Young with Dr. Pablo Prichard empowers viewers with practical, science-based strategies for achieving improved health and well-being. Each week, Forever Young takes audiences on a scientific deep dive to discover more about critical links in the chain of human health such as diet, sleep patterns, exercise, and mental health and resilience. Forever Young with Dr. Pablo Prichard will reveal the fascinating science behind our bodies, and how lifestyle choices can accelerate or slow aspects of the human aging process.
